description: This file defines functions and constants related to calculating and handling directional headings (up, down, left, right) for elements in a graphical or diagramming context, including logic for determining heading based on points and element geometry.

methods.name: vectorToHeading
methods.description: Converts a vector to a discrete heading (up, down, left, right) based on its direction.

methods.name: headingForPoint
methods.description: Determines the heading from a point to an origin point.

methods.name: headingForPointIsHorizontal
methods.description: Checks if the heading from a point to an origin point is horizontal.

methods.name: compareHeading
methods.description: Checks if two headings are identical.

methods.name: headingIsHorizontal
methods.description: Checks if a heading is horizontal (left or right).

methods.name: headingIsVertical
methods.description: Checks if a heading is vertical (up or down).

methods.name: headingForPointFromDiamondElement
methods.description: Calculates heading for a point relative to a diamond-shaped element based on geometric analysis.

methods.name: headingForPointFromElement
methods.description: Calculates heading for a point relative to a generic element, handling diamond shapes specifically.

methods.name: flipHeading
methods.description: Returns the opposite direction of a given heading.
